mapper.sql: id, operation_id, note_id, operation_type, content_uuid, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error, lease_owner, lease_until, lease_version, created_time, updated_time, completed_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_note_content_saga (operation_id, note_id, operation_type, content_uuid, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_version, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{noteId}, #{operationType}, #{contentUuid}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_note_content_saga WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM t_note_content_saga WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND lease_until > NOW() FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_note_content_saga (operation_id, note_id, operation_type, content_uuid, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error, lease_version, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{noteId}, 'COMPENSATE', #{contentUuid}, NULL, 'COMPENSATION_PENDING', 0, NOW(), #{lastError}, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE note_id = VALUES(note_id), operation_type = 'COMPENSATE', content_uuid = VALUES(content_uuid), payload = NULL, status = 'COMPENSATION_PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = NOW(), last_error = VALUES(last_error), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, lease_version = lease_version + 1, completed_time = NULL, updated_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_note_content_saga WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'DELETE_PENDING', 'COMPENSATION_PENDING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
